mechanism_claim.functional_claim: The ASAL open-endedness score (asal_metrics.py:52-64) is the mean over frames of each frame's maximum embedding inner-product with any STRICTLY EARLIER frame (tril k=-1), minimised; the frames are 8 evenly-spaced samples of a 256-step rollout (rollout.py:78-95). The score therefore rewards a frame sequence whose every frame is embedding-dissimilar from all its predecessors -- a property of the observed frames in the foundation model's space, not of the underlying dynamics. CLAIM: a search restricted to LEGITIMATE Lenia parameters (configurations that are ALIVE by an independent mass criterion) can drive an ALIVE rollout's score below the score that scene-level GARBAGE achieves through the same observer, by producing embedding-drifting frames rather than anything one would call dynamical novelty; and the raw Lenia catalogue, without search, does not cross.
mechanism_claim.claimed_inputs: Lenia parameters (R, T, m, s, kernel/growth choices, initial pattern) drawn from the catalogue and its envelope; the 8 sampled frames' embeddings
mechanism_claim.claimed_outputs: the open-endedness score; and the classification (genuine dynamical novelty / metric exploit / observer exploit / not alive) of the best ALIVE crosser
mechanism_claim.claimed_internal_dependency: the score reads only z (the frame embeddings); no internal simulation state enters it (asal_metrics.py:52-64); the frames that reach it are exactly the K=8 sampled by rollout.py:78-95; Harmonia's independent metric agrees with the fossil's to 5.6e-16 (float64), so the boundary is the score of record
mechanism_claim.known_uncertainty: whether Lenia's reachable frame sequences contain embedding-drift as strong as free-image garbage (the operator's open question); the exact crossing margin; the observer is CLIP ViT-B/32 in the port, not ASAL's Flax CLIP (an INSTRUMENT_CHALLENGE Harmonia has waived to 5.6e-16 on the metric)

interventions.prediction_rationale: if the catalogue alone crossed, the exploit would not require search and I1/I2 would say nothing new; predicting it does not cross makes any crossing a product of search

cheat.failure_interpretation: if the parameters change the score of fixed frames, the pipeline leaks state into the score and the boundary asal_metrics.py:52-64 is not the whole score

negative.failure_interpretation: if a blank world does not hit the (T-1)/T ceiling or is called ALIVE, the ALIVE filter or the score's construction is not as the boundary states

cut_kill.observation: Harmonia's independent metric disagrees with the fossil's calc_open_endedness_score beyond float tolerance, OR a blank world does not score (T-1)/T = 0.875
cut_kill.consequence: the score in play is not the max-cosine-to-strictly-earlier-frame mean at asal_metrics.py:52-64; the boundary is mislocated and a NEW CUT is required (this packet stays immutable)

indeterminate.observation: any of: the minimum ALIVE score lands within float tolerance of its threshold (I1 at 0.8167, I2 at 0.7999); the best crosser classifies UNCLASSIFIED on Harmonia's frozen thresholds (I3); no ALIVE rollout is found in the whole 1045-rollout budget; the imported port's asal_metrics or Lenia bytes at run time do not match the fixture's hashes (a different instrument was measured)
indeterminate.consequence: the affected row returns PREDICTION_INDETERMINATE rather than a directed verdict; if no ALIVE rollout is found the packet returns INTERFACE_INSUFFICIENT (the ALIVE filter or the substrate port admitted nothing to score), not a crossing verdict
